verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS fraud and identity platform's source is open-licensed is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any source repository or open license for Alloy. The publicly served OpenAPI document, the docs .md mirrors and the SDK mention are API descriptions and developer surfaces, not product source under an open license, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
